note: Danske Bank's price book (updated 7 October 2026), read 2026-10-30 for its Mastercards: the Mastercard Basis (250 kroner a year), Guld (795) and Platin (1,395), each with a standard yearly card fee (none inside some customer programmes, which the game doesn't hold). With the usual 100% repayment each month no interest is charged from purchase to the due date, so nothing is carried; the 5, 10 or 15% monthly repayment the holder may choose instead carries interest from the due date at a rate the price book doesn't state, so it isn't written. Each: a cash withdrawal on the credit function at Danske Bank's machines or counters costs 1% (at least 20 kroner); paying in a currency outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and Britain costs 1.5% (written as the foreign fee; 0.5% on EEA currencies isn't modelled); a payment reminder costs 100 kroner, written as the late fee. The Mastercard Hverdag+ (199 kroner a year) is offered without a credit assessment and can't be used on credit, so it isn't written. Replacement, express and courier charges aren't written. The main banks: Danske Bank, Denmark's largest, is the only one written; Nordea's and Jyske Bank's Danish card price lists weren't reached on 2026-10-30. The earlier reading of the Mastercard Basis (2026-10-29) holds and is kept. Two card companies were added in wave 4, Nordea's Danish card page not being at its address (404) and Jyske Bank's answering with a Cloudflare check, each a large Danish credit card issuer whose card page gives its full price table, read 2026-10-30. Bank Norwegian: the Bank Norwegian card, no yearly fee and no fee for an invoice in e-Boks (35 kroner on paper, a choice not written), 19.99% a year nominal (21.93% debit rate and APR), up to 45 interest-free days (grace 45), no cash withdrawal fee in Denmark or abroad (none written), a 1.99% currency surcharge, and a 100-krone reminder fee written as the late fee (the 100-krone debt-collection notices and the 100-krone fee for pulling back a Betalingsservice payment aren't written). re:member: the re:member Mastercard, no card fee, invoice or Betalingsservice charge, 19.95% a year nominal (21.88% debit rate), up to 52 interest-free days (grace 52), and 2% on a cash withdrawal in Denmark or abroad, at least 50 kroner (the 2% on a transfer to a NemKonto isn't written); its table gives no currency surcharge.
